evals.prompt: Install the revise-docs guard for this project: project-scoped settings, default doc-file set, guard only doc-sweep-enabled repos, and gate on git commit (not push).
assertions: Copies the hook script to a stable path under the project's .claude/hooks/
Also copies doc-classify.mjs into the same directory as the copied hook script so the classifier resolves at runtime
Writes a config JSON capturing docPatterns (a glob list)/repoScope AND trigger:"commit" AND an excludeDirs array
Merges a PreToolUse matcher:Bash hook entry into the project settings.json referencing the copied hook + config, preserving any existing settings
Offers to seed the review marker on this fresh install (seed-now / review-now / leave) rather than silently leaving it unset
Prints a structured summary listing the settings/hook/classifier/config paths, the trigger, marker state, bypass tokens, and how to edit/uninstall
Re-running the install does not duplicate the hook entry (idempotent)
For the default exempt-set choice, omits exemptPatterns from the config JSON so the classifier's built-in test globs apply

evals.prompt: Uninstall the revise-docs guard from this project.
assertions: Removes the guard PreToolUse entry (the one referencing doc-sweep-revise-push.sh) from settings.json
Deletes the copied hook script, the copied doc-classify.mjs next to it, and the config JSON
Leaves unrelated settings (other hooks/keys) untouched
Leaves the per-clone review marker file in place (does not delete it)

evals.prompt: I already installed the revise-docs guard here but I want to switch it from push to commit. Reconfigure it.
assertions: Detects the existing install and offers Reconfigure / Uninstall / Cancel rather than doing a blind fresh install
On Reconfigure, rewrites the config JSON with the new trigger while preserving the other choices
Leaves the review marker file untouched during reconfigure (does not re-seed it)
Updates the settings.json matcher only if the hook path or settings location changed

On Reconfigure, unconditionally re-copies doc-classify.mjs next to the hook script (self-heals a missing or stale classifier) even when the hook path itself is unchanged and the hook script is not re-copied

evals.prompt: Install the guard user-global for all repos, default trigger. This repo vendors a third-party library under vendor/ and has a git submodule.
assertions: Scans for likely-vendored directories (submodules, non-root package manifests, known vendor names) and presents candidates for confirmation
Persists the confirmed excludeDirs list into .claude/context/audience-rules.md
Mirrors the same excludeDirs into the hook config JSON written next to the hook

evals.prompt: Install the revise-docs guard for this project, and also exempt the package-lock.json lockfile from requiring docs.
assertions: Records exemptPatterns in doc-sweep-revise.json as the built-in default test globs (e.g. **/*.test.*, **/tests/**) FOLLOWED BY the user's addition (package-lock.json), rather than replacing the tests with only the addition
Persists the same exemptPatterns list into .claude/context/audience-rules.md, the same way docPatterns/excludeDirs are persisted
Functionally, with that config, the hook treats a package-lock.json-only change (or a test-only change) as not requiring docs while a src-code change still blocks
